messages:
Maya: scheduling a quiet canary for inference v3.2 tonight at 21:30 UTC. need smoke owner + rollback owner. planning percent ramp: 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% (10m between steps). cohorts: small US-west slice, then EU non-prod, then global.
Andre: I can own smoke checks, will be available 21:15-22:00 UTC.
Sam: I'll be rollback owner and monitor alerts. set me as pager at 21:20 please.
Jax: quick question — do we want an initial 0.25% hold for 5m to reduce blast radius?
Maya: thinking 0.5% is fine given previous stability, but ok to add 5m hold if you prefer. keep ramp windows but add a short extra hold before 5%.
Andre: agreed. final plan: 0.5% (5m) -> 5% (10m) -> 25% (10m). I'll run smoke after each step.
Maya: smoke checklist (short):
- health endpoint ok
- run two exemplar queries (text gen + chat)
- p95 latency delta < 150ms
- error rate < 0.1% (rolling 5m)
- logs show kv-cache warm events
Please post PASS/FAIL in this thread.
Sam: I'll watch Grafana: p95, p99, error budget, rate-limited 429s. threshold alerts: p95 > 1200ms OR errors > 0.1% => rollback.
Andre: smoke commands I'll run:
```bash
# quick health
curl -fsS https://canary.internal.redwood/health | jq .status
# sample gen (5 queries)
python tools/canary_runner.py --model v3.2 --queries smoke_qs.txt --timeout 8
# curl one chat flow
curl -sS -X POST https://canary.internal.redwood/v1/chat -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CANARY_KEY' -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"summarize the attached bug in 1 line"}]}' | jq .
```
Maya: rollback plan (if smoke FAIL or alerts trigger):
1) stop canary traffic (route 0%)
2) rollback to v3.1 with pinned config
3) invalidate KV cache warmers and restart pods if needed
Rollback command: `rcli rollback --service inference --to-version v3.1 --reason "canary fail"`
Sam: I'll be ready to execute rollback and notify CS + infra. @eng-oncall please stand by from 21:20-22:00 UTC.
eng-oncall: standing by 21:20-22:00 UTC, will escalate if pager triggers.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by Maya at 2025-10-17T21:30:00Z (canary v3.2 -> 0.5%).
Jax: one more: ensure batch/continuous-batching toggle is on for canary to mimic real traffic.
Maya: confirmed — batching = on, cache warmers enabled. Andre please confirm you see warm events in logs after first step.
Andre: will report back. I'll post timestamps and PASS/FAIL markers here.
Maya: thanks everyone — lets keep thread for all check-ins. :thumbsup:
